name: get-event
description: Gets the details of one Google Calendar event (a meeting or appointment) by its id: title, description, times, location, recurrence, organizer, attendees and their responses, and the Meet link. google-calendar__list-events supplies the eventId; calendarId defaults to "primary" and google-calendar__list-calendars supplies others.

eventId.description: Google Calendar event ID supplied by list-events.

calendarId.description: Calendar ID supplied by list-calendars. Defaults to primary.
